channel.title: Hürriyet Daily News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Hürriyet Daily News (hurriyetdailynews.com)

item.title: Fidan calls Iran strikes on Gulf states ‘wrong strategy’ as war spreads
item.description: Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan on March 3 described Iran’s strategy of bombing Gulf countries “without making any distinction” as “an incredibly wrong strategy,” and stressed a change in Iran’s leadership could create a rare opportunity to halt the escalating conflict.

item.title: Ethnobotanical heritage around Lake Sapanca documented
item.description: A TÜBİTAK-backed study led by researchers at Sakarya University documented how 112 plant species growing around Lake Sapanca are traditionally used by locals, recording their medicinal, nutritional and cultural significance

item.title: EU seeks to stem industrial decline with 'Made in Europe' push
item.description: The EU unveiled Wednesday new "Made in Europe" rules to help bolster the bloc's industries against fierce competition from China in a push held up for months by wrangling over plans some see as overly protectionist.

item.title: Türkiye’s culinary capitals lead in obesity, diabetes rates
item.description: Türkiye’s celebrated culinary capitals, provinces famed for their rich, indulgent cuisines, are also topping a far less enviable ranking: Obesity and diabetes prevalence.

item.title: Turkish universities launch Thrace, Marmara quake monitoring network
item.description: Six Turkish universities have launched a 24/7, real-time geodetic monitoring network to track earthquake-related ground deformation across Thrace and the Southern Marmara region.

item.title: Türkiye 'leaving nothing to chance' regarding security of its borders: Erdoğan
item.description: President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan on Wednesday vowed that Ankara is "leaving nothing to chance" when it comes to the security of its borders and airspace in these hard times the region is going through.

item.title: Seoul leads rebound across Asian stocks, oil extends gains
item.description: Asian equities jumped Thursday after a three-day rout sparked by the Middle East war, but concerns about an extended conflict helped oil extend gains, while analysts warned of more volatility ahead.

item.title: Israel keeps up Lebanon strikes as ground forces advance
item.description: Israel's attacks on Lebanon entered a fourth day on Thursday, killing at least two according to state media, after Israeli forces pushed into border towns and conducted air strikes targeting Iran-backed militant group Hezbollah.

item.title: Fidan discusses Middle East, intercepted Iran-fired missile with Rubio
item.description: Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan and U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio discussed the latest situation in the Middle East in a phone call on Wednesday, including an Iranian ballistic missile that was directed toward Turkish airspace but neutralized, Turkish diplomatic sources said.

item.title: Israel, Iran launch fresh attacks as war spreads
item.description: Israel pounded Lebanon early Thursday and said it intercepted missiles from Iran as a widening war launched by the United States and Israel also brought fresh turmoil to Iraq.
